nodes.label: Design: Browse Files Item Targets and File Actions
0. What changed from the previous revision of this design
D1. The primary Browse icon target lives in BrowsePage, not in FileActions
D2. The icon anchor is nested **inside** the existing `.f-icon` cell, not substituted for it
D3. Two sibling anchors, not one merged anchor
D4. The icon target's accessible name is an action label, distinct from the name link's
D5. `FileActions.render()` keeps returning the container for every item; only its *controls* change
D6. Removal of the `open` action definition, not just its suppression
D7. No `stopPropagation()` / `preventDefault()` in the Browse row
D8. `data-file` on every file target is mandatory, not conventional
D9. CSS scope: icon-anchor rules, plus a content-independent action track
D10. Header row and skeleton rows are unaffected
File Action ownership boundary (added by the Phase 3.5 consolidation analysis)
D11. Complete File Action ownership is confirmed as already satisfied; no helper movement is required
D11a. The action track is pinned so column alignment is content-independent
